change_summary: Add efficiency guidelines instructing the agent to request the order ID first, batch/parallelize order lookups, and stop searching once the target is found.
reason_for_change: get_order_details is the dominant tool (40 calls), driven by tasks that brute-force every order one-at-a-time and re-fetch to find user-described items (tasks 103, 54, 23). Instructing the agent to ask for the order ID up front, batch lookups, stop early, and avoid re-fetching reduces both redundant tool calls and the assistant turns spent narrating each fetch, lowering mean cost per task while the explicit deference to <policy> preserves success.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.636307 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The agent fetches order details one-at-a-time and re-fetches all orders to find items the user describes (e.g. task 103 pulled 5 orders, task 54 pulled 6, task 23 pulled 4); a prompt instruction to batch/parallelize lookups and stop after finding the target reduces redundant tool calls and the turns spent narrating each.
